question.text: 'Advisory' service under SEBI PM Regs is characterised by:

answer.text: Ownership of securities remains with client; PM only advises
PM is paid only on performance

explanation.text: The Logic: Advisory = PM provides recommendations; client holds securities directly; no portfolio management/custody. The Trap: Advisory doesn't handle custody — that's a regulatory distinction. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A covers; XXI-B tests boundary. Manager's Pro-Tip: Advisory fees are lower (no custody/dealing cost) but scale differently — fewer clients needed if ticket sizes are large.
